texts.ig:
POV: a sunny day off Funchal, Madeira, and the Atlantic is this blue. Your own boat, two skippers, and the red cliffs of the south coast right above you.

We slow down where the water turns turquoise, then everyone gets in: swim, paddle board, back on deck for something to eat. No other group on board, just yours.

Day Trip, 2h30 or 3h, leaving at 10:00 or 14:00, five guests at most.

Tap the link in our bio to book.
